The '''ISB Central Office''' was the headquarters of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] that handled all of the communications and coordinations tasks for the organization. It was a massive office complex located in the [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Commission of Operations]] would transmit assignments through the Central Office to the [[Sector Officer]] in charge of the relevant operational branch. Operations conducted between branches in the same [[Sector/Legends|sector]] or cross-sector operation were coordinated by the Commission of Operations and directed by the Central Office.<ref name="IS2" />

It was here that [[Gray Paladin]] [[Laranth Tarak]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kajin Savaros]] were taken after their capture. A [[Battle in the Imperial Security Bureau|battle]] was fought here when [[Whiplash]] affiliates [[Jax Pavan]], [[Haninum Tyk Rhinann]], and [[I-5YQ]] attempted to rescue their friends.<ref name="CNIII:PoF">''[[Coruscant Nights III: Patterns of Force]]''</ref> Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Imperial Security Bureau prepared a report for the ISB Central Office, which in turn was added by Rebel Alliance [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Arhul Hextrophon/Legends|Arhul Hextrophon]] to a compilation of Imperial documents for Alliance [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and other Rebel [[Officer/Legends|officers]].<ref name="IS2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ISB Central Office was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity by the [[1989]] ''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]'', which was authored by [[Greg Gorden]] and published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="IS">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
